table.retrieve:
SELECT  
	serviceheader.serviceinvcode , 
	serviceheader.date , 
	InvTotal = serviceheader.InvTotal,
	serviceheader.remarks , 
	custcode=serviceheader.custcode,
	accounts.name,
	posted = serviceheader.posted,
	PostedBy = IsNull((Select username from users 
				where dbo.serviceheader.postedby = dbo.users.usercode), ''),
	ModifiedBy = IsNull((Select username from users 
				where dbo.serviceheader.modifiedby = dbo.users.usercode), '') ,
	FullPatientName=FullPatientName,
	patient=(select name from patient where patient.patientcode=Serviceheader.patientcode),
	patientregno=(select Regno from patient where patient.patientcode=Serviceheader.patientcode),
	Gender=(SELECT P.Gender FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode=serviceheader.PatientCode),
	Age=(SELECT P.AgeYears FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode=serviceheader.PatientCode),
	RefBy=PatientRefBy,
	Ref1=Ref1,
	Ref2=Ref2,
	Remarks=serviceheader.Remarks,
	HeaderNo=serviceheader.HeaderNo,
	PatientCode=serviceheader.PatientCode,
	studentregno=(select Student.Regno from student where student.studentcode=Serviceheader.studentcode),
	student=(select Student.Name from student where student.studentcode=Serviceheader.studentcode),
	studentClass=(select C.Name from student, Class C where student.studentcode=Serviceheader.studentcode and student.currentclass=C.classcode),
	StudentCode=ServiceHeader.StudentCode
FROM
	accounts , 
	serviceheader
WHERE 
	:as_showrows = 'Y' AND 
	( dbo.serviceheader.servicecatcode IN(12, 11 )) and
	(dbo.serviceheader.date > :ad_invdate) and
	( serviceheader.admissioncode IS NULL ) and 
	( serviceheader.custcode = accounts.acccode ) and 
	( Posted IN (:as_Posted))
